scope: Native/CLI conformance for typed LEFT/RIGHT outer multivalue results, explicit AbsentMultivalue marker and independent parent/element nullability; existing native source callbacks reused

checks.command: cargo test --locked --offline -j2 -p tablecraft-access --test multivalue_outer_results --test multivalue_results --test multivalue_join_results -p tablecraft-cli --test multivalue_outer_queries --test multivalue_join_queries
cargo clippy --locked --offline -j2 -p tablecraft-access --lib --test multivalue_outer_results --test multivalue_results --test multivalue_join_results -- -D warnings
cargo clippy --locked --offline -j2 -p tablecraft-cli --test multivalue_outer_queries --test multivalue_join_queries -- -D warnings

test_migrations: Two existing direct/INNER metadata patterns now explicitly require parent_nullable:false; element nullability/type expectations unchanged.
Existing native bare-list LEFT refusal became a DISTINCT LEFT refusal because outer joins are now admitted; DISTINCT remains unsupported before native records.
Existing CLI INNER/CROSS target negative now uses list ON comparison in LEFT JOIN, preserving unsupported pre-scan coverage; CLI owner made that migration.
acceptance: Synthetic ACE2007/ACE2016/ACE2019 LEFT and RIGHT results distinguish present[], present[NULL], ordered duplicate/NULL lists and AbsentMultivalue. Scalar partner cells use NULL when missing.
Missing-side OutputType parent_nullable is independent of element_nullable, retaining the same Int32 element descriptors/local collection index0 on both sides.
Nested LEFT then RIGHT propagates absence for two missing inputs while retaining present lists, including empty/NULL-member lists on the preserved side.
Hidden nullable-side .Value criteria select matched parents and retain the full duplicate/NULL list.
Host-authorized linked/external targets retain exact scoped list values and missing-parent markers under one native budget.
A scalar-only nullable leaf performs no child-record I/O for an unselected corrupt page; selecting its list reads and fails.
Scalar API rejects collection outputs before records. Native/query limits, cancellation and eager later expression errors return no typed result.
CLI prints absent parent as NULL outside brackets, stored NULL member as[NULL] and stored empty list as[]. Error/output limits leave stdout empty; temporary inputs remain byte-identical.
limitations: No Access adapter production code changed; the separate query/API and CLI renderer slices own runtime behavior.
Only the five listed focused targets were executed; unique tests are counted once.
Synthetic byte fixtures establish TableCraft conformance, not native Microsoft Access SQL qualification.
Original public-writer/getter replay is separate parent-owned evidence and is not counted here.
The scalar-only watcher proves no child-record I/O; it does not count backend-neutral callback-method invocations.
